caption: Precision @ L/2 on the same 314 natural proteins (97 validation + 217 test) for every method. MarinFold uses the fixed 248B-token model and the original 100 iid samples per protein: mean single, consensus and ground-truth oracle best-of-100. Standard predictors use the same selected archived structures, ranking emitted ConFind-positive contacts by pLDDT_i × pLDDT_j × contact degree. Filter resolved endpoints and separation >=6 (all) or >=24 (long) before selecting floor(input L/2); unfilled ranks score zero. Original sampling consensus votes over all parsed maps; main contact-panel votes omit unfinished maps. Bars are equal-protein means with existing 95% protein-bootstrap error bars. No scores, intervals or predictions were recomputed for this comparison. Sources: pl2_sampling_comparison_summary.csv and pl2_sampling_comparison_rows.csv, which retain pointers into the original sampling and poster-product tables. See SAMPLING_L2.md.
